text: A Deceitful Merchant with Sweet Treats
Lefina is trying to make decent sweets.\nHowever, Filecia has doubts about her...\nAnyway, collect the ingredients for the sweets!
You follow the merchant who received the sweets and found\nhim making a deal with Broker Goblin! Defeat Broker Goblin\nto teach the merchant a lesson!
You have defeated Broker Goblin and taught the merchant who\ndeceived Lefina a lesson. Let's go back to Lefina for now!
